name: Terry Davis: The Modern World Is Horribly Desolate
aliases: the modern world is horribly desolate
beauty and the desolation of the modern world
description: Terry Davis in black sunglasses on a city sidewalk: "You see the beauty and the desolation of the modern world. The modern world is horribly desolate. That's biblical. Desolation is the punishment. Catastrophic success. The young lions lack prey."
usage: Doomer commentary on modern life, cities, tech or the internet. Catastrophic success.
